note: Exploratory extension. Copy of scenario_rerun_nano_haiku.json with only models, smoke_models and these notes changed; same code fingerprint d3c871e37e928ad6. Models were selected by Ryan before testing.
model_notes: Unchanged client request for every model and mode: temperature 0, reasoning effort low with excluded reasoning text (minimal on the truncation retry), response_format json_object. OpenRouter lists all three for all four models. Provider routing is left to OpenRouter; the provider serving each call is recorded. At Ryan's instruction, Qwen and Kimi were restored after the MiniMax and GLM cells finished and run on the same frozen settings for comparability, despite failing the assertion probe. Their cells ran after the other two models' cells, not interleaved. The reasoning-off diagnostic is not used.
unusable_rule: A run is unusable if it has a harness error, no successful model call, or at least half its calls failed or were rejected. Two consecutive unusable runs stop that model; its remaining cells are reported as not run.
